regime.label: Neutral

components.label: Liquidity
components.description: Proxy via short-term cross-sectional return dispersion (lower = tighter spreads)

components.label: Credit
components.description: XLF 20d momentum relative to universe median

components.label: Commodities
components.description: XLE + XLB relative strength vs universe

components.label: Dollar
components.description: Requires FX price data (DXY/UUP). Not in current price upload.

components.label: Rates
components.description: Requires Treasury yield data (IEF, TLT). Not in current price upload.

components.label: Earnings Revision
components.description: Requires EPS consensus data. Not derivable from prices.

regime.drivers: Supported by Liquidity. Headwinds from Trend, Breadth, Credit.

factors.name: Momentum
factors.description: Medium-term total return over the configured lookback.

factors.name: Trend Quality
factors.description: Stability and explanatory strength of the log-price trend.

factors.name: Volatility
factors.description: Annualized realized volatility; lower values receive stronger normalized scores.

factors.name: Drawdown / Risk Fit
factors.description: Maximum peak-to-trough loss over the configured lookback.

factors.name: Mean Reversion
factors.description: Short-term reversal measured from recent return relative to peers.

factors.name: Relative Strength
factors.description: Return in excess of a configured benchmark over the same window.

factors.name: Diversification / Correlation Benefit
factors.description: Low average correlation to the rest of the investable universe.
